checked_claims.claim: Scope, designer, player count, components and setup
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.12–14 and p.24
checked_claims.details: 2–4-player base scope; marked starters on Market; Merchant in Orleans; 5 coins, 7 markers, 10 stations; 13 Citizens placed and one reserved; all stated component totals; Pilgrimage first; random goods and exact 2/3-player reductions.

checked_claims.claim: Seven phases, Census and draw/recovery restrictions
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.14–15,21
checked_claims.details: 18 rounds; tied Census leaders/last pay nothing; 2-player last-place exception; Market capacity and retained tiles; decline draws to recover assigned Followers; no direct Action Space transfer; bag inspection and reshuffling.

checked_claims.claim: Planning, action timing, passing and tile destinations
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.14–18,21
checked_claims.details: Simultaneous planning with order fallback; partial completion and unused activations persist; alternating one action/pass; passing final; ordinary used Followers to bag, Technology retained; Town Hall to permanent Deed spaces.

checked_claims.claim: Village rewards and timing, track limits, Monks and Technology
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.16–17
checked_claims.details: Recruit to bag; Boatman final Citizen; Craftsman technology only after pass; acquired Place special ability immediately available; first Trader category I then I/II; end-track recruitment barred; exact six Technology constraints and no substitute for required Monk.

checked_claims.claim: Movement, construction and Beneficial Deeds restrictions
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.18,21
checked_claims.details: One connection; at most one good; empty routes allowed; station occupancy and Orleans exception; exact Deed professions, marked-starter ban, coin/development choice for Canalization, completion Citizen, permanent destination.

checked_claims.claim: Town Hall same or separate action turns before passing
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.15,18 plus 2015 base-clarification-invasion-2015.pdf p.3 Town Hall cross-reference
checked_claims.details: The 2015 publisher text explicitly uses Town Hall as precedent for any/all placed Followers in same or separate actions. The base passing rule bounds these turns. No cross-round partially-used Town Hall cleanup is inferred.

checked_claims.claim: Original Bathhouse, Laboratory, Sacristy and Tower exceptions
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.16,23
checked_claims.details: Original Bathhouse draw-three/choose-two and unplaceable fallback; first Technology Farmer constraint applies to Laboratory; Sacristy resolves during Event Phase; Tower uses its special Market/planning/Deed procedures.

checked_claims.claim: All six events, food fallback and Plague
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf p.20
checked_claims.details: Three of each event; Pilgrimage during Actions; Income by status; Harvest food to Market then 5 coins/torture; Taxes per complete group of three goods; Trading Day built stations; Plague bag draw returns neutral to game board without marker retreat, marked draw causes no loss or redraw.

checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf p.21
checked_claims.details: Each missing coin replaced by one allowed item; built/unbuilt station allowed; bag-only random eligible Follower with marked redraw; development cannot move onto/past coin space; surrendered items removed; only development regained; shortage bars actions providing missing tiles and supplies may recover through events; coin shortage prevents receiving coins.

checked_claims.claim: Development, game end, scoring and tiebreak
checked_claims.source: 2014 matching-rulebook.pdf pp.14,19
checked_claims.details: Onto/past coins/Citizens/status; status starts 1; finish eighteenth round and event; unique station leader receives reserved Citizen; coins 1, goods 1/2/3/4/5; built stations plus Citizens multiplied by status; development position then shared victory.
